instruction: Show a real-time chart of memory usage for all variables in the current Python file inside VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible. Displaying live memory usage charts for variables within VS Code requires real-time profiling extensions and runtime execution that cannot be verified through static evaluators. This is comparable to the original task - both require dynamic runtime visualization features that are not standard VS Code capabilities and cannot be reliably tested.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly classified as infeasible - live memory usage charts require runtime execution and real-time monitoring
Static evaluators cannot verify live/dynamic visualization features that require continuous updates
Task requires specialized VS Code extensions with runtime profiling capabilities that cannot be reliably verified through state checking
The infeasible() evaluator function is the semantically correct choice for tasks that cannot be verified through static state inspection
